title: $300 Google Cloud free trial credits for new builders
discount_summary: $300 in credits for eligible new Google Cloud users.
ai_summary: Good starter credit for builders testing hosted AI, storage, databases, and deployment workflows. Check billing settings before launching paid resources.

title: GitHub Student Developer Pack with cloud and dev tool perks
discount_summary: Bundle of developer, cloud, domain, and learning perks for verified students.
ai_summary: One of the highest-signal free bundles for student builders. Best for early projects that need hosting, domains, monitoring, and learning credits.

title: Vercel Hobby plan for personal projects and prototypes
discount_summary: Free hosting tier for personal, non-commercial projects.
ai_summary: Useful for fast prototypes and landing pages. Teams and commercial usage should review the Pro plan limits before relying on the free tier.

title: Cloudflare developer platform free tiers for Workers and storage
discount_summary: Free tiers across Workers and several developer platform services.
ai_summary: Strong option for globally distributed apps and automation. Review per-product limits if combining Workers, KV, R2, D1, and Queues.

title: Resend free email API tier for early projects
discount_summary: Free email sending tier for developers building transactional email.
ai_summary: Good fit for newsletters, waitlists, and transactional email in MVPs. Verify sending limits and domain setup before using it for production campaigns.

title: AppSumo AI and SaaS lifetime deal watchlist
discount_summary: Rotating lifetime and annual discounts for SaaS and AI tools.
ai_summary: High volume source for SaaS discounts, but deal quality varies. Best handled as a monitored source with editorial selection instead of blind auto-publishing.

title: OpenAI business workspace credit promotions watch
discount_summary: Workspace credit promotions occasionally appear for eligible business customers.
ai_summary: Worth monitoring because credits can be valuable, but eligibility and dates change quickly. Keep as review-only unless an official current promo page is verified.

title: beehiiv newsletter platform creator plan watch
